text:
Before I touch anything: do you want this sorted (files moved into subfolders by type, nothing deleted) or also pruned (deleting installers, duplicates, and old files)?

Unless you say otherwise, I'll do this:

1. Scan read-only and report what's taking the 38 GB, plus exact duplicates and installers.
2. Move files into subfolders (Installers, PDFs, Images, Archives, Other), leaving anything modified in the last 7 days where it is.
3. Put deletion candidates in a list for your approval. I won't delete anything without it.

Moves are reversible because I'll log every original path. Deletions aren't, which is why they wait for your OK.
